messages:
Lenora (Design): quick pass on the batch vectors preview + export modal — flagged a couple accessibility and UX flow issues. dropped a Figma update: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Amit (Frontend): saw it, thanks. can you list the top 2 problems so we can triage?
Lenora (Design): sure — 1) selection state disappears when you paginate (users think selection is per page). 2) export modal focus doesn't return to a sensible control after close (focus lands on a hidden container). also microcopy for export CTA is ambiguous.
Jasper (A11y): for #1 we need to announce selection counts with an aria-live region (e.g., "3 rows selected"). also persist selection across pages in the UI, not just visually — otherwise screen reader users lose context.
Priya (PM): product preference: default export should be JSONL since embeddings are newline-delimited vectors, but we should show "CSV (column mapping)" as an option. UX needs to make mapping obvious for CSV.
Marta (Engineering): FYI backend already supports selection by vector_id across pages. UI currently drops it on full page refresh because we store in-memory. plan: keep localStorage + reconcile with server on load.
Amit (Frontend): implementation notes — I'll add a persistent selection store and wire an aria-live banner. Quick snippet for export mapping payload we discussed:
```
{
  "format": "jsonl",
  "fields": ["vector_id", "embedding", "metadata.title", "metadata.source"],
  "rows": ["id1","id4","id8"]
}
```
Ken (Product): microcopy suggestion: change button from "Export selected" to "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" so users immediately know format. for CSV option, show secondary CTA "Export CSV — map columns".
Lenora (Design): +1 on explicit file type in CTA. also accessibility nit: relevance-score pill color fails contrast at small sizes — currently ~2.3:1, need >=4.5:1. propose darker blue or switch to bold text on white chip.
Jasper (A11y): also add focus-visible outline for row actions and ensure each action button has aria-label like `aria-label="Open actions for row with id id1"`. Modal should use role="dialog" and trap focus with aria-modal=true.
Priya (PM): decision question: when user selects rows across pages, the header CTA should show count and a dropdown: "Download (3) ▾" with choices. If they clear selection, should we persist last export mapping? prefer yes for power users.
Marta (Engineering): persisting last mapping is fine. we'll store mapping in user prefs and expose an "Apply recent mapping" shortcut in the modal.
Amit (Frontend): UI nit — when long metadata fields render in the preview table, we truncate with "..." but no tooltip on keyboard focus. Need a focusable tooltip (title attr isn't keyboard friendly).
Lenora (Design): agreed. use an accessible tooltip component that appears on focus and hover. and add a copy action for long text: small icon that copies full value to clipboard (aria-label="Copy full value").
Ken (Product): export edge-case: if a user selects >10k rows we should warn about size and suggest server-side job or zip. copy for warning: "Large export may take several minutes — we'll email you when ready." short and clear.
Jasper (A11y): last: ensure table header sort buttons have aria-sort and announce sorting changes via aria-live when toggled.
OpsBot: design-env deploy completed — staging updated with figma changes. :party-parrot:
Lenora (Design): sweet. next steps: Amit to add aria-live + persist selection; Marta to add mapping persistence; Ken/Priya to finalize CTA copy; Jasper to write a short a11y checklist for the PR. back here by EOD Tuesday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
